text:
alex: Morning — nightlies red on l4-quant-warmup: job 18432 failed on gpu-l4-12 with OOM during model warmup. Full job: https://ci.redwood.ai/internal/18432
mai: thanks, adding link. Can you paste the tail of the log?
alex: ```
[2026-03-16T23:42:11Z] warmup: allocate kv cache...
CUDA Error: invalid device function
GPU 0: H100-L4 (driver 525.89)
OOM: requested 1.2G, free 900M
stack: driver_kernel.c:120 kernel_launch failed
```
corey: invalid device function + driver 525 on node with host 535 update sounds like libcuda mismatch.
sasha: we rolled host drivers to 535.54 on canary pool yesterday. Containers still on 525-linked images.
ryan: quick triage: if container libcuda < host driver, you'll often see `invalid device function` or XID 31. Also OOM behavior if kernel falls back.
alex: ci-bot queued a generic rerun but we need targeted rerun on nodes pinned to driver 525 and separately on 535 to confirm.
ci-bot: Re-run requested: job 18432 (user: alex). Rerun queued on default pool.
mai: @eng-infra can you route the rerun to these node labels: `driver:525`, `driver:535` ? Also hold canaries for 30m if possible. :pray:
eng-infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-927 to schedule targeted reruns and hold canary autoscaling. ETA ~15m.
corey: I can bisect commits between last green (commit a1b2c3) -> HEAD. But I need both environment reproductions to rule out code vs driver.
alex: queued two reruns: one with ENV `REDWOOD_QUANT_DISABLE=true` and one default. Links: https://ci.redwood.ai/internal/18432/rerun/525 and https://ci.redwood.ai/internal/18432/rerun/535
ryan: if 525 rerun passes and 535 fails -> driver regression. If both fail -> code/quant change. If disable-quant passes -> quant path regression.
sasha: infra note: there was a kernel patch on 535 that enabled new PTX path; could break older quant kernels.
alex: will attach full `dmesg` from gpu-l4-12 after rerun if it fails again.
mai: thanks — keep updates here. tagging eng-oncall if rerun shows widespread failures. :mag:
corey: starting a quick bisect now, will post first failing commit within an hour or when found.
alex: thanks everyone.
